claim: queryFailedCount queries FROM cdc_system.cdc_activity_log for oom_15m and oom_1h counts.
flow: 1. queryFailedCount runs raw SQL against cdc_system.cdc_activity_log. 2. Counts rows with status = 'error' and 53200/53300/out of memory.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/data-hub/cdc-cms-service/internal/infra/observability/system_health_queries.go:113-122
	db.Raw(
		`SELECT
			count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > ?) AS oom_15m,
			count(*) AS oom_1h
		 FROM cdc_system.cdc_activity_log
		 WHERE created_at > ? AND created_at <= ?
		   AND status = 'error'
		   AND (error_message ILIKE '%53200%' OR error_message ILIKE '%out of memory%' OR error_message ILIKE '%53300%' OR error_message ILIKE '%too many clients%')`,
		fifteenMinAgo, oneHourAgo, now,
	).Scan(&oomRow)

claim: queryFailedCount queries cdc_system.snapshot_progress sp with LEFT JOIN cdc_system.source_object_registry so and LEFT JOIN LATERAL on cdc_system.shadow_binding s, aliasing sp.error_msg AS error_message.
flow: 1. queryFailedCount selects sp.id, COALESCE(...) AS table_name, sp.status, sp.rows_processed, sp.total_rows, sp.started_at, sp.updated_at, sp.error_msg AS error_message. 2. Joins source_object_registry and LATERAL shadow_binding.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/data-hub/cdc-cms-service/internal/infra/observability/system_health_queries.go:126-148
		`SELECT
			sp.id,
			COALESCE(
				NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('.', sb.shadow_schema, sb.shadow_table), ''),
				NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('.', so.source_database, so.source_object_name), ''),
				CAST(sp.source_object_id AS TEXT)
			) AS table_name,
			sp.status,
			sp.rows_processed,
			sp.total_rows,
			sp.started_at,
			sp.updated_at,
			sp.error_msg AS error_message
		 FROM cdc_system.snapshot_progress sp
		 LEFT JOIN cdc_system.source_object_registry so ON so.id = sp.source_object_id
		 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
			SELECT s.shadow_schema, s.shadow_table
			FROM cdc_system.shadow_binding s
			WHERE (sp.shadow_binding_id IS NOT NULL AND s.id = sp.shadow_binding_id)
			   OR (sp.shadow_binding_id IS NULL AND s.source_object_id = sp.source_object_id AND s.is_active = TRUE)
			ORDER BY s.id DESC
			LIMIT 1
		 ) sb ON TRUE
